response.original_title: Manchester United F.C. - Greatest F.A. Cup Victories Volume 1
response.overview: Manchester United is a great club with a great FA Cup tradition. Now for the first time, you can savour on video all the best United action from the World's most pulsating Cup competition. It highlights a golden era spanning 1976-1985, featuring Old Trafford favourites like Stuart Pearson, Jimmy Greenhoff, Norman Whiteside, Gordon Hill and Bryan Robson. Filled with fast and furious commitment and stunning goals, this is your chance to re-live:  The Red Devils exhilarating semi-final replay  triumph over arch rivals Liverpool in 1979.  The 2-1 final win over the same Merseyside giants at Wembley in 1977.  The 4-0 Wembley final demolition of Brighton in 1983.  The 10-men triumph over Everton in the 1985 final.  The 2-0 semi-final defeat of Derby in 1976 and the thrilling extra-time 2-1 toppling of Arsenal in 1983.  This compelling video is a must for all football fans!
response.title: Manchester United F.C. - Greatest F.A. Cup Victories Volume 1
